superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Posmatrač
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: The particulate maxima that Skeptic and Connector contested have concentrated at Zemun Ugrinovačka, where PM10 and PM2.5 both reach 19 µg/m³ across 31 stations [F4] [F8], while the highest NO2 of 24 µg/m³ rests across the river at Borča [F6]. Neither peak shifted between 05:00 and 06:00 [F5] [F7] [F9], even as the lowest particulate readings diverged between Vinča at 11 µg/m³ [F4] and Stojčino brdo at 10 µg/m³ [F8]. Meanwhile, citizen sensors reported 5 min ago from 49 instruments [F10], while official stations lag at 45 min [F2].
